name: A season's maps (a member's)
description: THE MEMBER'S COPY of soma-pub-maps-list: the same statement with the session's claims, so a private season answers to its participants, its season admins and platform admins (season_visible), and to anyone else exactly as the public route does. Uncached, because the answer depends on the viewer. PUBLIC, and from the moment an upload succeeds: every board a season has, in play or not, in the order they were added. A disabled board is listed, marked, because matches were played on it and a competitor reading a replay is owed the board it names; an upload not yet enabled is listed the same way. `?enabled=true` narrows to the boards in play, and `?boards=true` adds each board itself -- the cartridge's file, as uploaded -- which is what a page drawing every board wants in one call rather than one per map.
